profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer@ Asurion | AI, Technology Architecture | Leader
profile.summary:
Strategic and visionary Engineering Leader, Principal Software Engineer, Data Architect with years of experience designing robust data solutions, managing data infrastructure, driving enterprise-wide data strategies. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, lead a team of engineering, defining technical roadmaps, optimizing data architectures, and aligning data initiatives with business goals and enabling data-driven decision making. Passionate about mentoring and growing engineering talent while fostering innovation and organizational success.

Key Competencies:
•      Data Engineering & Architecture: Data warehouse, lakehouse, data modeling, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks), TOGAF principles, Data Mesh concepts.
•      Gen AI : GenAI/NLP to data analytics solutions. Development with cursor, copilot, claude data models
•      Big Data and Cloud Data Solutions: AWS, Azure, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, CDP
•      Data Governance & Compliance: GDPR, SOX, Collibra, Alation
•      Engineering Leadership & Mentoring: Building and leading high-performing teams, hiring, mentoring, performance management and career development.
•      Cross-functional Leadership and communication: Technical and business teams’ alignment, stakeholder engagement, project management, priority management.
•      ETL/ELT & Data Pipelines: DBT, Airflow, SQL, Python, Spark scala, CI/CD, metadata integration, DQM, Melissa data
•      GenAI integration: Implementation of AI driven data solution
•      Business Intelligence & Analytics: Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, SSRS, SSAS
